About Tina

Curiosity,
made tangible.

I’m a product designer and creative technologist working across screens, data, and space.

My path from fine arts to product design has made me equally comfortable with a sketch, a prototype, and the code that brings it to life.

I’m completing my MS at USC Iovine and Young Academy, following an MFA at Claremont Graduate University. My work spans interfaces, data visualization, spatial computing, and interactive art.
